title: ReModel
text:
This is the website for ReModel - a club for healthcare simulation enthusiasts to meet and engage in reusing open simulation models.
Our mantra when it comes to healthcare simulation is Read, Run, Reuse.
There is already a wealth of simulation models that are not being used to their full potential. ReModel is a project that aims to change this by making it easier to read, run, and reuse open simulation models.
If you are a healthcare analyst with an interest in simulation, or a simulation modeller who wants to learn how to better share your work, then ReModel is for you.
This website is a hub for ReModel activities. ReModel is hosted by the Strategy Unit.
Find out more about taking part and take a look at previous and upcoming sessions.

title: Code of Conduct
text:
Community rules:

Be respectful: Treat all participants with respect and kindness. Harassment, discrimination, or any form of abusive behavior will not be tolerated.
Camera and microphone etiquette: When participating in video calls, ensure your camera and microphone are used appropriately. Mute your microphone when not speaking to minimize background noise. We ask that you keep your camera on during sessions to foster a more engaging and interactive environment, but we understand that there may be circumstances where this is not possible.
Stay on topic: Keep discussions relevant to the purpose of the community. Off-topic conversations should be taken to private messages.
Share knowledge: Contribute your expertise and insights to help others. Be open to learning from others as well.
Report issues: If you encounter any problems or witness rule violations, report them to the moderators.

title: How ReModel Works
text:
ReModel will run in 2 monthly cycles, with each cycle focusing on a different simulation model. Each cycle will consist of two sessions: an exploratory session and a technical session.
Session 1: Exploratory session - this session will be an opportunity to explore the model, understand its structure and assumptions, and discuss potential use cases. Participants will be encouraged to ask questions and share their insights.
Session 2: Technical session - this session will focus on the technical aspects of the model, including its implementation, data requirements, and potential challenges. Participants will have the opportunity to work with the model and gain hands-on experience.
Each session will last for 1 hour, and will follow a participative discussion format.
Cost: All sessions are free for NHS participants.

title: About ReModel
text:
Building a simulation model from scratch is a time-consuming and resource-intensive process. ReModel aims to make it easier for healthcare analysts to read, run, and reuse existing open simulation models. We recognise that within healthcare there is a potential to reuse existing models because many of the problems faced by healthcare systems are similar as are many of the pathways experienced by patients. ReModel is a project that aims to make it easier to read, run, and reuse open simulation models.
Our goal is to empower people within the NHS to:

run open source simulation models on their own machines
critique/assess/evaluate simulation models with their pros and cons
repurpose existing simulation models for their own use cases
